questions.text: Which musical's red-haired heroine sings "Tomorrow" and has a dog called Sandy?
questions.explanation: Annie is a musical about an orphan in 1930s New York.

questions.text: Which long-running musical features a chandelier crashing down in a Paris opera house?
questions.explanation: The falling chandelier is a signature moment of Phantom.

questions.text: Which composer wrote both "Cats" and "The Phantom of the Opera"?
questions.explanation: Lloyd Webber wrote both hit shows.

questions.text: In which Austrian city is "The Sound of Music" set?
questions.explanation: The von Trapp story takes place in and around Salzburg.

questions.text: Which 2015 Broadway hit tells the story of a Founding Father who appears on the ten-dollar bill?
questions.explanation: Hamilton, by Lin-Manuel Miranda, opened on Broadway in 2015.

questions.text: Which musical features the song "Defying Gravity"?
questions.explanation: "Defying Gravity" closes the first act of Wicked.
Richard Rodgers and Oscar Hammerstein II created it.

questions.text: Which musical, based on a Victor Hugo novel, includes "I Dreamed a Dream"?
questions.explanation: Fantine sings "I Dreamed a Dream" in Les Miserables.

questions.text: Which jukebox musical is built around the songs of ABBA?
questions.explanation: Mamma Mia! premiered in London in 1999.

questions.text: Which musical, based on "Pygmalion", features Eliza Doolittle?
questions.explanation: Lerner and Loewe adapted Shaw's play as My Fair Lady.

questions.text: Who composed the score of "West Side Story"?
questions.explanation: Bernstein wrote the music; Stephen Sondheim wrote the lyrics.

questions.text: Which Kander and Ebb musical is set in the Kit Kat Club in 1930s Berlin?
Which Stephen Sondheim musical features a murderous barber on Fleet Street?
questions.explanation: Sweeney Todd opened on Broadway in 1979.

questions.text: Which Jonathan Larson musical, premiered in 1996, is loosely based on Puccini's "La Boheme"?
questions.explanation: Rent reimagines La Boheme in New York's East Village.

questions.text: Which was the first musical to win the Pulitzer Prize for Drama, in 1932?
questions.explanation: Of Thee I Sing, by the Gershwins and Kaufman and Ryskind, was the first.

spares.text: Which musical features a nanny who arrives with a magic umbrella?
spares.explanation: Mary Poppins flies in under her umbrella.

spares.text: Which musical includes "Summer Nights" and "You're the One That I Want"?
spares.explanation: Both songs are from Grease (the film version).

spares.text: Who wrote the lyrics for "Fiddler on the Roof"?
spares.explanation: Jerry Bock wrote the music and Harnick the lyrics.
